label: PPLR Data Maps
note: Monolithic composite (capability 3): ONE root .vue nests ten internal views of the PPLR people-group data (religion, ROP tree, language families, semantic trees, PG name locales, ROP sunburst, all pins, cross-system ID rosetta, translation coverage, index) behind a view-switcher. index.js registers exactly ONE tag (pplr-data-maps); no view is independently embeddable.
